description: This file defines the Vtiger_MailBox class which manages interactions with an email mailbox, including connecting via IMAP, searching emails, fetching messages, and managing connection state. It is part of the MailScanner module in the vtiger CRM project.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailBox
classes.description: Class to work with server mailbox, handle IMAP connections, message retrieval, and folder management within the vtiger CRM MailScanner module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the mailbox settings and determines the correct port based on the protocol and SSL type.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the mailbox using provided connection parameters or saved connection URL.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a specific mailbox folder, reusing existing connection if possible.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches emails in a folder based on last scan time or provided search query.

methods.name: getFolders
methods.description: Lists all folder names available in the connected mailbox.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a specific email message and returns a Vtiger_MailRecord object.

methods.name: markMessage
methods.description: Marks a message with a specified flag, e.g., '\Seen'.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the IMAP connection, optionally expunging deleted messages.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages for debugging or informational purposes, controlled by the debug flag.
